topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Well, well, well. Looks like the missus has been spinning yarns about our little life together, huh? Who'd have thought it? Bet she's been hiding away, fingers flying over that typewriter, getting all the little secrets and tales on paper. Gotta admit, there's a real thrill in finding out you're the hero of a story you didn't know you were in. Course, I'll have to read it first, see if the plot holds up to the real deal. Might even throw in a couple of surprises of my own. Tonight, we dine out, catch a show. Celebrate the muse, you might say. Things are looking up, in more ways than one.
